note: Common dashboard warning lights. Colour sets the urgency: red = stop safely now, amber = act soon, green/blue/white = information. Symbols and behaviour vary by maker: the car's handbook wins. [table]

colours.red: stop safely as soon as you can; do not drive on
colours.amber: something needs attention soon; drive gently and get it checked

lights.name: oil pressure
lights.means: engine oil pressure is too low
lights.do: stop and switch the engine off at once; check the level when safe; do not restart if the light stays on: tow it

lights.name: coolant temperature
lights.means: the engine is overheating or coolant is low
lights.do: stop, switch off, let it cool for at least 30 minutes; never open the cap hot; top up and find the leak, or tow it

lights.name: charging system
lights.means: the alternator is not charging the 12 V battery
lights.do: switch off heating, heated seats and other loads; drive straight to a safe place or a garage; the car will stop when the battery is flat

lights.name: brake system
lights.means: the parking brake is on, or brake fluid is low, or there is a hydraulic fault
lights.do: release the parking brake; if the light stays on, stop: test the pedal gently, do not drive with a soft or sinking pedal

lights.name: power steering
lights.means: steering assistance has failed (amber on some cars: reduced assistance)
lights.do: the steering still works but is heavy; stop safely, restart once; if it stays on, drive slowly to a garage or call for help

lights.name: airbag
lights.means: an airbag or belt pre-tensioner fault
lights.do: the airbags may not fire in a crash; safe to drive carefully, but get it checked soon

lights.name: seat belt
lights.means: someone is not belted in
lights.do: belt up

lights.name: door open
lights.means: a door, the bonnet or the boot is not shut
lights.do: stop and close it; an open bonnet can fly up at speed

lights.name: engine
lights.means: the engine computer has logged a fault, often emissions-related
lights.do: steady: drive gently and have the code read soon. Flashing: a misfire is happening now; ease off, avoid load, stop soon, or the catalytic converter may be damaged

lights.name: abs
lights.means: anti-lock braking is off
lights.do: the brakes still work but can lock on slippery roads; leave more room and get it checked. If the red brake light is on too, stop

lights.name: stability control
lights.means: flashing: the system is working. Steady: it is switched off or faulty
lights.do: flashing: you are at the grip limit, ease off. Steady: check it was not switched off; if not, get it checked

lights.name: tyre pressure
lights.means: a tyre is under-inflated; flashing then steady means a sensor fault
lights.do: slow down, check all four pressures cold as soon as you can; reset the system after inflating

lights.name: glow plugs
lights.means: diesel pre-heating; flashing while driving means an engine management fault
lights.do: wait for it to go out before starting; if it flashes while driving, treat it like the engine light

lights.name: diesel particulate filter
lights.means: the exhaust filter is filling with soot
lights.do: drive at a steady higher speed for 15-20 minutes as the handbook describes; if it stays on, a garage must clean it before it blocks

lights.name: adblue
lights.means: exhaust fluid is low (red or a countdown: nearly empty)
lights.do: top up soon; many cars will not restart once it runs out

lights.name: low fuel
lights.means: the fuel reserve is in use
lights.do: refuel; running a diesel dry can mean bleeding the system

lights.name: brake pad wear
lights.means: the brake pads are near their limit
lights.do: book new pads soon; braking still works for now

lights.name: bulb failure
lights.means: an exterior light is out
lights.do: check all lights and replace the bulb; a dead brake light or headlight is a fine in most countries

lights.name: washer fluid
lights.means: the washer reservoir is low
lights.do: top up; use winter fluid below freezing

lights.name: epc
lights.means: a throttle or engine power control fault (a label some makes use)
lights.do: power may be limited; drive gently and have it read

lights.name: service
lights.means: a service is due, or on some makes a powertrain fault
lights.do: check the display for a message; book a service

lights.name: frost warning
lights.means: the outside temperature is near freezing (typically from +4 C down; red at or below 0 C on some cars)
lights.do: bridges and shaded stretches may be icy: slow down, lengthen the gap, smooth inputs

lights.name: limited power
lights.means: an electric or hybrid car has cut power to protect the battery or motor
lights.do: ease off and find a safe place; it is often a cold, hot or nearly empty battery

lights.name: high-voltage system
lights.means: a fault in the high-voltage battery or drive of an electric or hybrid car
lights.do: stop safely, switch off, do not touch orange cables, call the maker's assistance

lights.name: main beam
lights.means: main beam headlights are on
lights.do: dip for oncoming traffic and when following

lights.name: front fog lights
lights.means: front fog lights are on
lights.do: switch off when visibility improves

lights.name: rear fog light
lights.means: the rear fog light is on
lights.do: use only below about 50 m visibility and switch it off afterwards: it dazzles drivers behind

lights.name: cruise control
lights.means: cruise control or the limiter is active
lights.do: information only; do not use cruise control on ice or standing water
